purpose: Apply the user-approved CD feedback batch without changing existing stable identities or deleting user data.

generation.prompt: Generate the candidate-only batch op-feedback-2026-08-14. Lock each item to its word, proposed or existing sense locator, POS, selected WordNet 3.0 synset and target meaning. Use local WordNet lines only as licensed semantic anchors, the current runtime and identity lock only for identity and adjacent-sense exclusion, and only field-level CLEARED runtime fields as text inputs. Do not use feedback text, user identity, attachments, search results, dictionary pages, paid content, SemCor, historical external translation, or any source of unknown rights. Independently write only justified candidate fields, while adding a related field when a requested translation cannot legally or semantically stand without replacing its source field. Every English definition, example and Chinese field must remain strictly bound to the target sense; examples must use the target word in the target POS and exclude adjacent senses. Chinese must be concise and natural without meta-language shells. Apply D-019: no unrelated sexual content and no China-related political or ideological content. If the requested synset is not a direct lexical identity for the intended sense, return evidence_pending instead of inventing an identity. Record per-field hashes, evidence references, model details, target binding, adjacent-sense exclusion, bilingual alignment and residual risk. Key identity decisions: review uses 00696852-v for refreshing memory rather than the broader requested 00696189-v; advocate uses 00827730-v; stress cause-strain uses 01798452-v; power 11453016-n means physical power/rate, not energy; service maintenance uses 00456937-v; British exam-study revise has no direct WordNet 3.0 revise identity and must remain evidence_pending.
